Definition: from G5259 and G3403; to remind quietly, i.e. suggest to the (middle voice, one's own) memory:--put in mind, remember, bring to (put in) remembrance.
BiblicalUsage: hypomimnḗskō is a plain word for put in mind, remember, bring to (put in) remembrance. In John 14:26, the text says "and bring all things to your remembrance."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hypomimnḗskō as it stands: put in mind, remember, bring to remembrance.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
